title: cymbidium boreale
intro: Cymbidium boreale, commonly known as the Korean orchid, is a type of flowering plant in the orchid family (Orchidaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory function, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Cymbidium boreale include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. However, the specific bioactive constituents and their effects on human health require further research for a comprehensive understanding of its therapeutic actions.
